errors.evidence: The description identifies one of the metrics as 'QA представяне' (QA performance), but the legend in the chart clearly labels this metric as 'Accuracy'.
The description states that the final value for the 'Confidence' line is around 0.96-0.97. However, the chart shows the final point for this line is below the 0.96 grid line, at approximately 0.955.
The description omits the title of the chart, 'Llama3-8B on Movies', which provides essential context about the subject of the data.

The description claims the 'Confidence' line has an 'almost horizontal section' between x-values of 40 and 50. While the slope decreases in this interval, the line still shows a visible increase from approximately 0.93 to 0.94, so describing it as 'almost horizontal' is an over-generalization.
The description states that the x-axis has a tick label for 120, but the tick labels on the chart only go up to 100.
For the 'Confidence' line, the value at x=25 is approximately 0.92, not 0.90 as stated. The description incorrectly assigns it the same value as the point at x=20, despite a visible increase.
For the 'Confidence' line, the value at x=30 is approximately 0.93, not 0.91 as stated in the description.
